subject: Clerical Ability
title: Filing — Set 1
directions: DIRECTIONS: Apply standard alphabetic filing rules to each item: compare names unit by unit and letter by letter; treat surname prefixes (De, Del, San, Sta.) as part of the surname; disregard personal and professional titles; file nothing before something.
example: Example — Reyes, Ana files before Reyes, Benito because A precedes B at the given-name unit.
